newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers up $1 in Med, steady elsewhere.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers up $1 in Med, steady elsewhere.

text.p: Mediterranean fuel oil bunker prices were about $1 firmer, but prices elsewhere, including ARA, were steady as a public holiday in the U.K. ensured minimal business.

Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was at $102/$103 fob. Barge market players offered fuel oil at slightly higher levels than at Friday's close, but some said this was due to uncertainty over market direction. Bunker dealers said enquiries were minimal, generally for tens of tonnes rather than in the usual lots of at least hundreds of tonnes.
Hamburg prices were unchanged from Friday.

Some Mediterranean prices, including those in Spain and southern France, rose by $1 a tonne. Dealers said this was the result of gains elsewhere in Europe on Friday and did not represent stronger demand.
